name: ClickUp
description: ClickUp is a work-management platform with a public API, webhooks, OAuth and an MCP server.
auth_notes: Personal API token (pk_ prefix) sent in the Authorization header for personal use; OAuth2 authorization code flow for apps used by others.
gate_detail: Public API is available on all plans, and a personal token is generated in account settings. Creating OAuth apps needs a Workspace owner or admin. Some user and guest endpoints are Enterprise-only. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Public API covering Workspace data, with an API spec, OAuth, webhooks and an MCP server; some endpoints and parameters are limited by plan.
mcp_notes: ClickUp-hosted MCP server documented on developer.clickup.com; feedback board labels it first-party and official, completed.
blocker_detail: Enterprise plan needed only for user and guest management endpoints; OAuth app creation requires a Workspace owner or admin.

evidence.quote: Authenticate to the ClickUp API using a personal token or OAuth.
Under API Token , click Generate or Regenerate .
Our Public API is available on all ClickUp Plans .
Only Workspace owners or admins can create OAuth apps.

issues: REST style is inferred from the v2 endpoint paths and spec, not labeled outright.
Rate limits are not covered in the sources.

searches.query: ClickUp API credentials pricing plan required developer access
